About TetraScience

TetraScience is the Scientific Data and AI Company building Tetra OS, the operating system for scientific intelligence. We help the world’s leading life sciences firms turn fragmented scientific data into AI-native assets and scientific workflows that accelerate discovery, development, and manufacturing. TetraScience’s growing ecosystem of strategic partners includes NVIDIA, Databricks, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Snowflake, Google, and Microsoft.

In connection with your candidacy, you will be asked to carefully review “The Tetra Way,” authored by our CEO, Patrick Grady; it is impossible to overstate the importance of this document, and you should take it literally as you decide whether our mission, culture, and expectations are right for you.

What You Will Do

You will join TetraScience's forward deployed teams as a senior, hands-on engineer. In this role, you will work directly with biotech, pharmaceutical, and scientific companies, bringing advanced data and AI technologies into the labs that research, develop, and manufacture medicines. You will work alongside customer scientific, engineering, and IT teams to design, build, and ship integrations and data products on Tetra OS that serve scientific teams across the globe. You will also mentor other scientific data engineers, lead internal design sessions, and partner with Product Managers and Solution Architects to turn customer, product, and engineering objectives into commercialized solutions.

  • Act as a forward deployed engineer for a portfolio of biotech, pharmaceutical, and scientific customers. Own the technical relationship, understand their scientific workflows, and deliver solutions that move their programs forward.
  • Drive AI agents to design and build bidirectional integrations between Tetra OS and customer systems such as ELN, LIMS, MES, and process historians, including serverless push and pull pipelines, stateful connectors, and full stack data applications in Python and TypeScript.
  • Drive AI agents to design and build comprehensive data schemas and parsers for scientific data from R&D lab instruments, manufacturing, CRO, CDMO, ELN, and LIMS sources, across formats such as .xlsx, .pdf, .txt, .raw, .fid, and many other vendor binaries.
  • Deploy and test solutions in customer environments, including cloud, on-premises, and hybrid networks, and troubleshoot across the full stack when something breaks.
  • Create and enforce designs with quality backed by comprehensive test automation to prove expected behaviors.
  • Lead process and technology improvements supporting product quality, developer experience, and platform capabilities.
  • Provide mentorship to junior scientific data engineers and show leadership on every front.

Requirements

We hire Sciborg team members with potential, passion, and values alignment, not just a checklist of requirements. If you have related skills and a desire to learn, we want to hear from you.

    About EH Group Engineering

    EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

    To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field.

    Based in the US? You’re welcome to apply. This is an on-site role in Nyon, Switzerland. We ask that you relocate within 3 months of starting, and we’ll support you with a relocation package.

     

    Key Responsibilities:

    • Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems

    • Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs

    • Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7

    • Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems

    • Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic

    • Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products

    • Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures

    • Manage the complete software life cycle, from requirements through release and maintenance, including dataset management

    • Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with industrial and certification requirements

    • Coordinate and develop the control team, including task planning and prioritization

    • Act as the main control interface with embedded, test and electrical engineering, as well as external partners and suppliers

     

    Skills and Experience Required:

    • BSc/MSc in control, electrical, mechatronic or automation engineering is mandatory

    • Minimum 7 years of experience in control engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior role

    • Skill 1 : Strong experience in process control engineering, particularly with containerized power supply systems; knowledge of programming and implementing safety PLCs is a strong plus

    • Skill 2 : Strong experience with TIA Portal (Step 7, WinCC, Test Suite), with the ability to structure code to industrial standards and meet certification requirements

    • Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions

    • Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management

    • Experience with stationary and maritime power applications, with a focus on the US and EU markets and their respective standards and certification requirements

    • Proven team player, with the ability to:
      (i) Coordinate and mentor the control team by clearly explaining your code and helping the team adopt robust industrial methods: you will take the responsibility in developing Skill 1 and Skill 2 across the team
      (ii) Collaborate effectively within interdisciplinary teams

    • Solid knowledge of control theory, state machines and system identification

    • Strong experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based design is a plus

    • Professional working language is in English.

       

    Start date: Immediately

    Purpose of the job

    The Director Research & Development (R&D) leads the exploration and development of potential business and technology initiatives, from initial ideation through feasibility analysis, testing, validation and proof of concept (POC)/prototyping. For assigned initiatives, the role coordinates the full exploration phase and develops substantiated proposals for consideration and approval by the relevant governance bodies.

     

    The role requires a proactive, self-motivated approach, the ability to work independently and to manage multiple subjects concurrently. Initiatives may range from joint venture (JV) model enhancements and artificial intelligence (AI) to customer experience development and new approaches to distribution.

     

    KEY RESULT AREAS/ KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

     

    Ideation and concept generation

    • Ensure that potential initiatives align with SkyTeam’s strategic goals and assess their purpose, expected value, rationale and the implications of not proceeding.
    • Ask relevant questions and gather appropriate information to support well-founded recommendations and help build consensus among member airlines.
    • Organize and facilitate ideation and brainstorming sessions.
    • Monitor developments in the transport industry and at IATA to identify emerging trends and opportunities or gaps for improving existing legacy systems.
    • Generate, collect and develop ideas and concepts in partnership with member airlines and other contributors for marketable initiatives that could become SkyTeam priorities.

     

    Exploration, feasibility and concept development

    • Lead the exploration of assigned initiatives, including relevant research and data analysis, feasibility assessments, business cases, business requirements documents (BRDs) and POCs/prototypes, as appropriate.
    • Analyze business and technical challenges across different airline domains; identify and assess potential solutions and determine the most relevant product concept, design and feasibility approach.
    • Develop evidence-based recommendations, supported by tangible data and analysis, that demonstrate the potential business value of the proposed initiative.
    • Prepare proposals and supporting materials for review and approval by the relevant SkyTeam and member-airline decision-making bodies.

     

    Stakeholder engagement and governance

    • Work effectively within SkyTeam’s matrix organization and collaborate with member airlines, internal teams and relevant external contributors.
    • Engage with operational and technical stakeholders, including senior decision-makers, to understand requirements, assess options and build alignment around proposed concepts.
    • Support informed decisions through clear analysis and recommendations. Strategic prioritization and formal initiative approval remain with the Executive Board (EB), Strategy Committee (StratCom) and relevant governance bodies.

     

    Transition to implementation

    • Following approval, coordinate with Digital/Delivery to transfer the agreed concept, supporting analysis, business requirements and relevant POC findings for MVP development and implementation.
    • Where assigned, act as project owner or coordinate relevant project activities within the agreed governance arrangements. Accountability for implementation transfers to Digital/Delivery.
    • Budget, resource or external-partner responsibilities may be assigned depending on the approved initiative and are not standing responsibilities of the role.

    Over ons

    De halfgeleiderindustrie vraagt om steeds krachtigere chips: meer bandbreedte, minder energieverbruik. Onze technologie levert precies dat. Wij verbinden chips met computernetwerken die enorme hoeveelheden data verwerken, met minimale vertraging. Samen veranderen we de manier waarop de wereld met elkaar verbonden is.

    In Zoetermeer werkt ons grafeenteam aan de toekomst van de halfgeleiderindustrie, van onderzoek en ontwikkeling tot industrialisatie. Op het snijvlak van materiaalkunde en halfgeleidertechnologie ontwikkelt het team de processen om grafeen te produceren, te karakteriseren en te integreren. Die processen vormen de basis van onze geïntegreerde grafeenfotonica. Het team pioniert met nieuwe procestechnologie en schaalt die op tot productierijpe oplossingen. Zo wordt baanbrekend onderzoek omgezet in de bouwstenen van de chips van morgen.

    De functie

    Black Semiconductor is op zoek naar een gemotiveerde Technicus (m/v/x) om ons team op locatie in Zoetermeer, Nederland, te versterken.

    Je speelt een cruciale rol bij het waarborgen van de betrouwbare werking van alle technische systemen die onze cleanroomomgeving ondersteunen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onderhouds-, storingsanalyse- en reparatiewerkzaamheden aan voorzieningen zoals luchtbehandeling, gas-, water- en elektrische systemen. Deze functie is ideaal voor een praktisch ingestelde professional met technisch inzicht die graag zelfstandig werkt, technische uitdagingen oplost en nieuwe vaardigheden ontwikkelt in een sterk gecontroleerde en innovatieve omgeving.

    Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

    • Zorgdragen voor een veilige en betrouwbare werking van cleanroomvoorzieningen, waaronder HVAC, toevoer- en afvoerlucht, gas-, water- en elektrische infrastructuur.

    • Uitvoeren van preventief onderhoud, storingsanalyse en reparaties aan productie en test apparatuur in de cleanroom en cleanroom systemen en inkomende nutsvoorzieningen.

    • Technische problemen diagnosticeren en oplossen om stilstand tot een minimum te beperken en de operationele continuïteit te waarborgen.

    • Onderhoudswerkzaamheden coördineren en uitvoeren, met inachtneming van normen en veiligheidsvoorschriften.

    • Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor technische uitdagingen en proactief mogelijkheden identificeren voor systeemverbeteringen en een hogere betrouwbaarheid.

    Jouw kwalificaties

    • Afgeronde beroepsopleiding in een mechanische, technische of onderhoud gerelateerde richting (bijvoorbeeld automonteur, industrieel monteur, mechatronicatechnicus of vergelijkbaar).

    • Praktische ervaring met mechanische systemen en basiskennis van elektrische, pneumatische, gas- of utiliteitssystemen.

    • Sterke hands-on mentaliteit met het vertrouwen om onbekende technische uitdagingen aan te pakken en nieuwe technologieën te leren.

    • Vermogen om zelfstandig te werken, prioriteiten te stellen en volledige verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor toegewezen taken.

    • Probleemoplossende instelling, sterke vaardigheden in storingsanalyse en bereidheid om te werken in een cleanroomomgeving met strikte kwaliteits- en veiligheidsnormen.

    • Comfortabel met praktisch werk in cleanroom-, laboratorium- en facilitaire omgevingen, inclusief het gebruik van ladders om verhoogde gebieden te bereiken en het werken in beperkte ruimtes onder de cleanroom wanneer dat nodig is.

    • In staat om fysiek veeleisende onderhouds- en installatiewerkzaamheden veilig uit te voeren, zoals het vervangen van HEPA-filters, het bedienen van afsluiters, het positioneren van gascilinders en het verplaatsen van zware vacuümpompen. Voor zware lasten worden geschikte hulpmiddelen en ondersteuning van collega’s ingezet.

    • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels, bij voorkeur ook in het Nederlands om te kunnen communiceren met externe partijen, management en operators.

    Ervaring in de halfgeleiderindustrie is niet vereist. Je ontvangt de nodige training en ondersteuning om de apparatuur te leren kennen en je technische vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen.

    Hoe succes eruitziet

    • Volledige verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de cleanroominfrastructuur, en zorgen voor een betrouwbare werking van luchtbehandeling, gas-, water-, afzuig- en elektrische systemen met minimale stilstand.

    • Uitgroeien tot een vertrouwde technische expert binnen het team, door proactief problemen te signaleren, praktische oplossingen te implementeren en bij te dragen aan een veilige en efficiënte werkomgeving.

    • Sterke zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel tonen, door onderhouds- en reparatiewerkzaamheden zelfstandig te beheren en effectief prioriteiten te stellen in een dynamische omgeving.

    • Technische kennis en vaardigheden continu uitbreiden, snel nieuwe systemen en technologieën eigen maken en tegelijkertijd de hoge standaarden handhaven die vereist zijn binnen een cleanroomomgeving.

    Onze werkcultuur

    Mensen boven processen. Bij Black Semiconductor is flexibiliteit essentieel — wij zorgen ervoor dat werk zich aanpast aan het leven, en niet andersom. We stimuleren een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé, waarin carrières betekenisvol en verrijkend zijn. Onze processen zijn mensgericht, zodat jij je kunt richten op wat echt belangrijk is.

    Laten we samen groeien. Jouw potentieel staat bij ons centraal. We bieden de autonomie om blijvende impact te maken en ondersteunen jouw groei met een cultuur van continu leren. We investeren in jouw professionele én persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

    Jouw gezondheid en toekomst zijn belangrijk. Jouw welzijn heeft de hoogste prioriteit. Daarom bieden wij een uitgebreid arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket met uitstekende verzekeringen, een pensioenregeling en virtuele aandelenopties voor jouw mentale, fysieke en financiële gezondheid. Jouw gemoedsrust staat bij ons centraal — nu én in de toekomst.

    Wij leven openheid. Samenwerking en inclusiviteit vormen de hoekstenen van onze cultuur. Wij geloven in openheid en bouwen aan vertrouwen en respect. Individualiteit is onze gezamenlijke kracht, die innovatie stimuleert en ons vooruit helpt.

    Wij verbinden chips – en mensen. Wij moedigen gekwalificeerde kandidaten van iedere achtergrond aan om te solliciteren. We creëren een inclusieve en ondersteunende werkomgeving waarin samenwerking, innovatie en groei centraal staan. Sluit je aan bij ons team en maak deel uit van een organisatie die een verschil maakt in de industrie.

    Kun jij jezelf zien in deze functie en binnen ons bedrijf? Laten we kennismaken.

    PURPOSE

    APR Consulting Co is a strategic production consultancy at the forefront of the advertising industry and is seeking an Associate Advisor, Integrated to join our team.     The Associate Advisor, Integrated, is a mid-level position responsible for the successful management of advertising production across broadcast, online video, social content, post-production, VFX disciplines. This role will help build and maintain relationships with client and agency points of contact, partnering with the senior team members, to support clients, agencies and internal teams.

    DEFINING SUCCESS FOR THIS ROLE

    This position will be successful if they can demonstrate the following objectives and performance targets:

    • Reliable Guidance: You support the client as a knowledgeable advisor, ensuring all standards are met and production partners (agencies, in-house teams, and vendors) maintain efficiency and risk management.

    • Integrated Support: Successfully supporting all aspects of production, post-production, and VFX projects, including budgeting, scheduling, and team collaboration across multiple creative partners.

    • Innovation Awareness: Demonstrating practical knowledge by leveraging the latest technology and AI workflow solutions to optimize processes and achieve cost efficiencies.

    Integrated Production Management

    • Support cross-discipline interaction on projects with assigned client/agency groups.

    • Vet production vendors for quality/value and support the negotiation of agency and vendor bids for best value.

    • Attend scoping, pre-bid, and strategy meetings to help align creative, schedule, and budget.

    • Enforce client policy, production guidelines, and best practices.

    VFX & Post-Production Oversight

    • Participate in Animation and VFX budget discussions and bid negotiations alongside broadcast SMEs and agency producers.

    • Review Animation and VFX production specs, schedules, and budgets for accuracy.

    AI & Innovation

    • Educate clients and APR teams on advancements in production technology, AI in the production workflow, animation, and VFX.

    • Seek out opportunities with clients to leverage and repurpose creative assets using emerging technology.

    • Stay up to date on emerging technology with AI in post-production, especially in Editorial, VFX, and workflow solutions.

    Internal Leadership & Reporting

    • Support the capture of APR savings according to established methodology and validate final job accuracy.

    • Act as a collaborative member of the team and participate in cross-team knowledge sharing.

    • Enter and validate all project information in APR’s database (Acero), including savings, KPIs, and cost drivers.

    • Participate in internal subject matter expert discussions and contribute to case studies.

    ABOUT YOU

    • Experience: 5-10 years of deep experience producing video content for an advertising or production company (line producer or EP).

    • Technical Literacy: Proficient in Google Suite and a working understanding of VFX programs, technology, and AI workflow solutions.

    • Soft Skills: Outgoing, collaborative, and diplomatic; able to impact and influence others on critically important projects.

    • Labor Knowledge: Knowledge of union crew labor, SAG rules, and regional market rates.

    Flexible Schedule: Enjoy a flexible schedule within our remote, global team. We prioritize your well-being, offering you the freedom to find a work-life balance that works for YOU.

    Dynamic Team Culture: Be part of a vibrant, collaborative team where enthusiasm, proactivity, inclusivity, curiosity, and authenticity are at the core of our values.

    Cutting-Edge Innovation: Engage with a team dedicated to pushing the boundaries in marketing &

    Recruiting Sourcer- 6 month contract

    Remote- US

    ABOUT THE ROLE:

    HiddenLayer is entering an exciting new chapter in our company history, and we are seeking a Recruiting Sourcer to help us identify and engage exceptional talent as we continue to grow. In this role, you'll build strong candidate pipelines for a range of technical and business positions, partner closely with the recruiting team and hiring managers, and help create a thoughtful, efficient candidate experience. You'll also own relationships and administrative responsibilities related to external recruiting partners, while supporting other recruiting operations as needed.

    WHO WE ARE:

    HiddenLayer protects the world’s most valuable technologies from adversarial AI attacks. We were founded by AI professionals and security specialists with first-hand experience of how insidious adversarial AI attacks can be to detect and defend against. Determined to prove that these attacks were preventable, the team developed a unique, patent-pending, productized solution to support organizations in accelerating their adoption of AI securely.

    Our dedication to innovation has been recognized by prestigious awards such as RSA's Innovation Sandbox Winner, CB Insights AI 100, CyberTech 100, and SC's Most Promising Early-Stage Start-up.

    WHAT YOU’LL DO:

    • Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to understand role requirements, define target profiles, and develop effective sourcing strategies.
    • Proactively identify, research, and engage qualified candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, talent databases, referrals, communities, and other creative sourcing channels.
    • Conduct thoughtful outreach and follow-up with prospective candidates, clearly communicating HiddenLayer's mission and opportunities while building long-term relationships.
    • Build and maintain organized, accurate talent pipelines in Greenhouse; document outreach, candidate information, and next steps in a timely manner.
    • Own relationships and administrative responsibilities related to external recruiters, including coordinating searches, tracking activity, maintaining records, and supporting communication and follow-up.
    • Assist with interview scheduling, candidate communications, requisition updates, reporting, and other recruiting administrative tasks as needed.
    • Help improve sourcing processes by sharing market insights, tracking outreach results, and recommending new tools, channels, and approaches.

    WHO YOU ARE:

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage candidates in a professional, authentic, and compelling way.
    • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple searches, priorities, and follow-ups in a fast-moving remote environment.
    • Comfortable learning and using recruiting tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Greenhouse, spreadsheets, Slack, and scheduling platforms.
    • Resourceful and curious, with the ability to research talent markets, find hard-to-reach candidates, and adapt sourcing strategies based on results.
    • A collaborative, service-oriented partner who works well with recruiters, hiring managers, candidates, and external recruiting partners.
    • Able to handle confidential candidate and company information with discretion and sound judgment.
    • Prior recruiting or sourcing experience is a nice to have; experience in recruiting coordination, talent research, customer service, sales, or another high-volume relationship-focused role is also valuable.
    • Available to commit to a six-month contract, with the possibility of extension based on business needs and performance.

    WHY HIDDENLAYER?

    We just raised $100M in Series B funding led by Delta-v Capital, with backing from Morgan Stanley, Microsoft's venture arm, Booz Allen Hamilton, and others. It's a validation of what we've built: 10x revenue growth, 50+ new enterprise customers, and deployments across defense, finance, and the world's largest AI platforms. This funding goes straight into expanding our platform and GTM capabilities, and into growing our team globally.

    Attracting and retaining the very best people is our #1 priority. That’s why we offer our team best-in-class benefits, including:

    Since 1998, we've been on a mission to reshape how players interact with their favorite games, growing into a global team of over 12,000 professionals spread across 70+ studios in 26 countries.

Player Engagement provides technical support, community management, and trust & safety services for a wide range of AAA and Indie studios in the gaming industry.

    Join us in our mission to build engaging player communities and offer outstanding experiences! 🎮🔥

    Role overview

    We’re looking for a Game Capture Artist who can start immediately and join our award-winning team. You'll stage, shoot and scrutinise in-engine shots across specialised development builds to create the best content possible for our clients.

    Our client list and fast growth come from a culture of no-waffle and a strong creative focus. The successful applicant will need to live those values and hit the ground running without heavy hand holding.

    What are we looking for? Our Project Manager has a knack for the following skills:

    • A passionate gamer with a broad appreciation of mobile, PC and console titles
    • A willingness to learn each game and its project setup inside out, and to stay hands-on with it every day
    • Someone who can adapt to game development builds and Unity projects that are always changing, including version updates, new scenes and shifting assets
    • An understanding of game trends and how games are marketed across the gaming landscape
    • Creative problem solving: finding ways around bugs, broken scenes and build issues to get the shot
    • A keen eye for composition, camera movement, lighting and framing
    • An eagerness to develop in-engine cinematography techniques and creative storytelling skills
    • A collaborator who can work efficiently with creative, editorial and client-side development teams
    • Strong proficiency in Unity (essential), including Cinemachine, Timeline, the Unity Recorder and working across URP/HDRP render pipelines
    • Working knowledge of Unreal Engine, including Sequencer, Movie Render Queue and cine cameras (highly desirable)
    • Previous experience in a game capture, in-engine cinematics or trailer production role (essential)
    • Knowledge of Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro
    • PC proficient, with experience capturing from both PC and mobile builds (Android/iOS)

    Your duties:

    • Create high-quality in-engine capture using game development builds and Unity projects. This means setting up cameras, staging scenes and characters, and rendering high-resolution, high-frame-rate footage through the Unity Recorder and, where needed, Unreal's Movie Render Queue
    • Meet capture deadlines, which can sometimes be very tight, and manage your own time efficiently
    • Keep a sharp eye on quality, pushing lighting, post-processing, resolution and detail levels to get the best possible image from each build
    • Select and stage shots that meet the brief, telling a story through capture and showing off each game and its features in the best possible light
    • Fully understand the latest build and project version of each game, and be the main point of contact for all game and engine updates
    • Edit captured footage in After Effects and Premiere Pro, using editing techniques to make it as exciting as possible
    • Build and maintain reusable capture setups, such as camera rigs, Timeline sequences and lighting presets, to speed up future work
    • Gather high-quality assets (characters, environments, UI, renders) and export them from the engine when needed

    Requirements

    You'd be a great fit for this role if you have:

    • Previous experience in a Game Capture Artist role.
    • A passionate gamer, especially one who enjoys mobile games.
    • Willing to learn the games inside out and play them frequently.
    • Able to adapt to ever-changing game development builds.
    • Understanding of game trends across the gaming landscape.

    • Competence with OBS Studio (not essential).
    • Knowledge of Adobe After Effects CC.
    • Proficient with both Mac and PC, with a focus on PC.
    • Able to use iOS devices.

    WICHTIG: Wir können nur Bewerbungen berücksichtigen, wenn du bereits selbst Werbeanzeigen im Meta Werbeanzeigenmanager (Facebook/Instagram) erstellt und bearbeitet hast. Ohne diese Erfahrung ist eine Bewerbung leider nicht sinnvoll.

    Du bist auf Facebook und Instagram zu Hause, arbeitest gerne sorgfältig und verlässlich und suchst eine Aufgabe für rund 25 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche, die du zu 100% aus dem Homeoffice erledigen kannst?

    Wir helfen Unternehmen dabei, durch digitales Recruiting die besten Mitarbeiter zu finden. Dafür läuft bei uns ein eingespielter Prozess: Wir wissen, welche Werbeanzeigen funktionieren, wie die Texte aufgebaut sind und wie eine Kampagne aussehen muss und welche Handgriffe es in Meta für eine erfolgreiche Kampagne braucht.

    Genau diesen Prozess sollst du bei uns abarbeiten - Schritt für Schritt, Kampagne für Kampagne.

    Wir wachsen weiter und suchen deshalb Unterstützung bei der Durchführung unserer Projekte.

    Deine Aufgaben

    Grundvoraussetzung für diese Stelle: Anlegen von Kampagnen in Meta (Verwendung des Ad Managers von Meta)

    Eingabe und Änderung von Meta/Facebook/Instagram Werbeanzeigen (Ads) im Meta Business Manager

    Du legst unsere Kunden in BVS an und erstellst die Verknüpfungen, so dass die Bewerber auch an den Kunden weitergeleitet werden.

    Betreuen unserer Recruiting-Kampagnen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Projektleiterin, nach unserem bestehenden System

    Als Urlaubsvertretung übernimmst du die Gestaltung von Kampagnen in Canva und erstellst die passenden Texte für neue Kampagnen. Du arbeitest mit unseren Vorlagen und setzt daraus ansprechende Anzeigen und Grafiken um.

    Du musst nicht (!) zwingend Vorerfahrung im Recruiting, HR oder Projektmanagement haben

    Das bringst du mit

    Du hast eingehende Erfahrung im Umgang mit Meta (Facebook/Instagram). Du hast Freude daran Anzeigen anzulegen, zu ändern und zu kontrollieren.

    Das Wichtigste vorweg: Unser Prozess steht, er funktioniert, und er ist in Vorlagen und Abläufen festgehalten. Deine Aufgabe ist es, ihn sauber, genau und verlässlich abzuarbeiten - nicht, ihn neu zu erfinden.

    Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit sind uns wichtiger als originelle Einfälle. Wer gerne nach einem klaren System arbeitet, ist bei uns richtig.

    Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wann etwas ansprechend aussieht? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich.

    Offenheit und Interesse an neuen Ideen, Programmen und Tools

    Eigenständiges Denken und sauberes, strukturiertes Arbeiten mit Hausverstand sind für dich selbstverständlich und keine Ausnahme.

    Du kannst gut damit umgehen, dass kurzfristige Todos immer wieder aufploppen, und priorisierst Aufgaben.

    Du arbeitest nicht nach starren Zeiten – kannst dich gut organisieren und einteilen.

    Sehr guter Umgang mit dem Computer (Windows oder Mac, MS Office)

    Regelmäßige Kommunikation deiner Fortschritte in internen Online-Meetings

    Ein Hinweis in eigener Sache: Ausgebildete und erfahrene Grafikerinnen und Grafiker sind bei uns unterfordert - die Aufgabe ist die Umsetzung mit Vorlagen, nicht die freie Gestaltung.

    Das bieten wir

    Teilzeit (25-30 Stunden / Woche), auf Wunsch später mehr

    Gemeinsame Zusammenarbeit online im kleinen Team mit eigener Verantwortung

    Du kannst nach unserem eigens entwickelten System arbeiten und bekommst alles beigebracht

    100% Arbeit aus dem Home-Office möglich – bitte keine Digitalen Nomaden

    Klare Abläufe statt ständig wechselnder Anforderungen - du weißt, was zu tun ist

    Gehalt: Wir bezahlen das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgehalt laut Kollektivvertrag für Angestellte im Gewerbe, Handwerk und in der Dienstleistung, Verwendungsgruppe 2, Einstieg ohne Vorerfahrung. Das sind € 2.059,41 brutto pro Monat bei Vollzeit (40 Stunden), 14-mal im Jahr. Bei 25 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche entspricht das € 1.287,13 bis € 1.544,56 brutto pro Monat. Eine Überzahlung ist nicht vorgesehen.

    Bitte beachte: Diese Stelle ist sehr begehrt - wegen der Freiheiten, die wir bieten, und weil du zu 100% im Homeoffice arbeitest. Eine Bewerbung ist deshalb nur dann sinnvoll, wenn du praktische Erfahrung mit Meta-Ads mitbringst, wenn das angegebene Gehalt für dich passt und dir bewusst ist, dass es in den ersten 2 Jahren nicht steigen wird (ausgenommen die jährliche kollektivvertragliche Anpassung). Andernfalls ist eine Bewerbung hinfällig.

    Art der Stelle: Teilzeit, Freie Mitarbeit, Minijob

    Interessiert? Melde dich bei uns und lass uns sprechen (Lebenslauf und deine Kontaktdaten reichen aus - kein Motivationsschreiben).

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Front-End Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6508/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Humane World for Animals
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://humaneworld.org">https://humaneworld.org</a>
</p>

<p><em>The general salary range for this full-time position is $80,000 – 115,000. Salary offers will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, skills, training and education.</em></p>
<p><em>&nbsp;</em></p>
<p>Humane World for Animals, a global leader in animal advocacy and protection, is seeking a Web Developer, eCRM to support Digital Marketing and other departments by providing front-end, global web development solutions for fundraising, advocacy engagement, and other strategic priorities — incorporating AI-assisted and agentic development tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining rigorous human oversight, quality, and security standards.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Collaborates regularly with Digital Marketing, Brand and Visuals, and IS teams to discuss project requirements and makes technical recommendations. Writes efficient code and maintains custom donation forms, advocacy forms, other webpages, and email templates. Incorporates best practices for user experience, accessibility, page speed optimization, and GDPR compliance implementation. Adheres to global regulations and standards, regional data compliance, and security compliance;</li>
<li>Uses AI-assisted development tools and agentic coding assistants to accelerate coding, refactoring, debugging, testing, and documentation. Proactively identifies opportunities for AI-assisted and agent-built solutions and owns the ongoing maintenance, monitors their performance over time and updates or retires them as needed. Follows established guardrails and usage standards for AI tools and applies human-in-the-loop review to all AI-generated code and configurations, validating output for accuracy, security, accessibility, and brand/technical standards before deployment;</li>
<li>Follows quality assurance procedures and troubleshoots technical issues affecting donation forms, advocacy forms, webpages, and email templates in Engaging Networks. Works closely with vendor partners;</li>
<li>Works with the Information Security team to ensure that digital properties meet security standards, including managing script inventory, attestation, and other requirements for PCI compliance;</li>
<li>Collaborates with the testing team to gather testing requirements and implement new features to run A/B and multivariate tests on forms;</li>
<li>Creates and maintains clear and concise documentation of custom web development, support guides, and incident reports;</li>
<li>Performs other duties as assigned.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Qualifications and Requirements:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor's degree in computer programming, web development, or related field, or equivalent work experience required;&nbsp;</li>
<li>A minimum of four (4) years of experience in front-end web development and developing custom websites required;</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience with Engaging Networks or other eCRMs;</li>
<li>Proficient in HTML5, Sass and CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, GitHub, Engaging Networks modules, Webpack, Node, npm, core AWS services, and Mailgun. Familiar with Segment or other CDPs;</li>
<li>Direct experience with AI coding assistants and agentic development tools such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot;</li>
<li>Knowledge of best practices for responsive, mobile-first web design, UX, accessibility, page speed optimization, browser support, and GDPR compliance;</li>
<li>Familiar with cookie consent tools, preferably Iubenda, for configuring compliance settings;</li>
<li>Experience building interactive data visualizations that translate campaigns into compelling stories for supporters to increase engagement;</li>
<li>Excellent attention to detail when coding projects based on Adobe XD files or Figma;</li>
<li>Understanding of digital marketing strategies for US and international audiences;</li>
<li>Stays on top of AI trends in web development, including personalization and workflow automation, and their responsible application to fundraising and advocacy technology;</li>
<li>Strong written and verbal communication skills;</li>
<li>Must be able to multi-task in a fast-paced, collaborative environment to deliver high quality work on deadline. Familiarity with Jira and Confluence a plus;</li>
<li>Data informed problem solver having experience with A/B testing platforms and Google Analytics;</li>
<li>Proactive and ability to work both independently and as an effective team member in a team environment;</li>
<li>Interest in animal protection issues preferred.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>This is a full-time remote position based in the United States.&nbsp;Candidates must be able to accomodate Eastern Time hours, as needed.&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Q<em>ualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, and disability, marital or parental status or protected veteran status.&nbsp; EOE</em>&nbsp;</p>

      <title>Doximity: Commercial Data Scientist</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.)
</p>

<h3><strong>Commercial Data Scientist</strong></h3>
<p>Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.&nbsp;</p>
<p>At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.</p>
<p><br><em>This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S.</em></p>
<p><strong>As a Commercial Data Scientist</strong>, you’ll work within cross-functional delivery teams alongside other analysts, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in discovering data insights to help improve healthcare.</p>
<p><strong>How you’ll make an impact:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Deliver novel and impactful insights for client organizations using machine learning and AI technologies.</li>
<li>Work closely with our Product, Platform Data, Insights &amp; Strategy, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses.</li>
<li>Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates and future projects.</li>
<li>Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform.</li>
<li>Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced environment to exceed client expectations</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team</strong></p>
<p><strong>As an organization we value diversity - </strong>in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Collaboration</strong>—The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.</li>
<li><strong>Passion for Data</strong>—You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights.</li>
<li><strong>Reliability</strong> – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success.</li>
<li><strong>Curiosity</strong> – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight.</li>
<li><strong>Respect</strong> – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>About you:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>At least <strong>4 years</strong> of professional experience as a Data Scientist or other related roles working with complex, high-volume, structured and unstructured datasets.</li>
<li>Prior experience in a data science consulting role at firms such as ZS, Trinity, IQVIA, BlueMatter, etc., where you thrived in a fast-paced environment</li>
<li>Advanced knowledge of statistical concepts — particularly exploratory data analysis, experimental design, and probability theory.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques</li>
<li>Proven ability to design, train, and evaluate large-scale production models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.</li>
<li>Advanced SQL proficiency — skilled at writing and optimizing complex queries across multiple tables and data relationships.</li>
<li>Advanced Python skills, including understanding of object-oriented programming, production-grade code design, and modern data science libraries.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with distributed data processing tools and concepts for scalable analysis and model training.</li>
<li>Excellent data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the capacity to translate technical insights into clear, compelling narratives for internal and client stakeholders.</li>
<li>Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Fun</strong> <strong>Facts About the Client Intelligence team</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections.</li>
<li>Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights.</li>
<li>The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds.</li>
<li>We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events!</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Compensation</strong></p>
<p>The anticipated total compensation for this role is $119,333 - $172,800 depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.</p>
<p>Our total compensation package may include:</p>
<ul>
<li>Base salary</li>
<li>Equity (where applicable)</li>
<li>Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable)</li>
</ul>
<p>Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Benefits</strong></p>
<p>In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:</p>
<ul>
<li>Medical, dental, and vision insurance</li>
<li>401(k) with company match</li>
<li>Flexible paid time off and company holidays</li>
<li>Paid parental leave</li>
<li>Professional development and learning opportunities</li>
<li>Wellness and mental health resources</li>
<li>Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable)</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Why You'll Love Working Here</strong></p>
<p>At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Make a real impact.</strong> Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.</li>
<li><strong>Work with exceptional teammates.</strong> Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.</li>
<li><strong>Enjoy flexibility and trust.</strong> We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.</li>
<li><strong>Grow your career.</strong> Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.</li>
<li><strong>Bring your authentic self.</strong> We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Our Hiring Process &amp; AI Tools</strong></p>
<p>Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity</strong></p>
<p><em>Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.</em></p>
<p><em>If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation.</em></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/doximity-commercial-data-scientist">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/doximity-commercial-data-scientist</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Hex Technologies: Legal Ops</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> NYC or Remote (EST or CST)
</p>

<p><strong>About the role:</strong></p>
<p>Hex’s legal function has gone from zero to a fully operating system in under a year. Now we need someone to own and scale the operating layer so it holds as the company grows. <strong>This is a builder role.</strong></p>
<p>You’ll run contract operations end to end: CLM administration, workflow optimization, template and playbook maintenance, enablement and training for the revenue team, and first-pass review and redlining of standard agreements against our playbook. Beyond contracts, you’ll build structured intake for every legal workstream across the company, own the legal governance record (privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars), manage outside counsel relationships, and own the legal tech stack. We sit at the nexus of data, AI, and collaboration, which means our legal operations have to be as thoughtful as our product.</p>
<p>We use AI tooling across legal operations, and you’ll work the same way: building agents and automations to move faster, not as a side project but as the default way things get done here. If you see a manual workflow and instinctively want to build it away, you’ll feel right at home.</p>
<p><strong>What you will do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Drive CLM adoption and enablement so the revenue team self-serves on standard deals</li>
<li>Own workflow optimization, templates, and playbooks as deal structures and products evolve</li>
<li>First-pass review and redlining of standard agreements; draft from templates as volume requires</li>
<li>Build and own structured intake for legal workstreams across the company</li>
<li>Build AI-powered workflows, agents, and automations that replace manual processes</li>
<li>Maintain the legal governance record: privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars</li>
<li>Train cross-functional teams on self-service tools and escalation paths</li>
<li>Manage outside counsel relationships and the legal tech stack</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>About You:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>3-5+ years in legal operations, paralegal, or contract management, with at least 1-2 years in-house at a tech or SaaS company</li>
<li>You’ve implemented or rebuilt a CLM (Ironclad preferred), designed intake workflows, and stood up reporting someone relied on</li>
<li>Experience reviewing and redlining commercial agreements on both sell-side and buy-side paper</li>
<li>You build with AI and automation as a natural part of how you work. You’re comfortable across AI-assisted legal tools, LLMs, and automation platforms, and willing to experiment with new ones as they emerge. This isn’t a nice-to-have at Hex.</li>
<li>Comfortable operating with autonomy in a role with a lot of white space</li>
<li>Good judgment about what you can handle and what needs a lawyer</li>
<li>You care whether people actually use what you build</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Nice to have:</em></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a company navigating exponential growth</li>
<li>Experience with corporate governance (entity management, board materials, annual filings)</li>
<li>Has used Hex</li>
<li>Strong opinions about the best way to organize a Notion workspace</li>
</ul>
<p>We know job posts like this can feel like a checklist, and nobody checks every box. If you’ve built legal ops infrastructure, you’re excited about AI, and this role sounds like the kind of work you want to do, we’d love to hear from you.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<p>In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary &amp; equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.</p>
<p>The salary range for this role is: $124,125 - $165,500.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness &amp; parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.</p>
<p>By submitting an application the candidate consents to the use of their personal information in accordance with the Hex Privacy policy:&nbsp;<span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id-754370997"><a href="https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy">https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy</a></span>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Hex Technologies uses AI-assisted tools as part of our application review process, including for resume screening and fraud detection. These tools help our <strong>team </strong>evaluate applications and verify applicant information. All AI-generated recommendations are reviewed by a member of our recruiting team before any hiring decision is made. No application is automatically rejected based solely on an AI tool's output.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hex-technologies-legal-ops">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hex-technologies-legal-ops</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Lithic: Senior Risk Associate</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote 
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.</p>
<p>Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.</p>
<p>We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.&nbsp;</p></div><p>We are hiring a Senior Risk Associate to run Lithic's risk assessment function: the client risk assessment program, the third party risk management program, and the enterprise risk assessment. You will execute the assessments, own the operations that keep them on schedule and defensible, and continuously improve the rubrics, questionnaires, registers, and SOPs that govern them. You will also own program underwriting: the criteria, limit and reserve recommendations, and periodic reassessment that follow a client from diligence through scale.</p>
<p>This is an AI-forward role. Lithic is deploying agentic tooling across diligence and documentation workflows, and this role owns that build in the assessment domain: testing, tuning, and documenting the tooling so routine collection, review, and drafting are absorbed by automation, while you own the judgment calls, the exceptions, and the written product that goes to partner banks and examiners.</p>
<p>This role operates with limited guidance and owns its programs end to end. It is sized for ownership, orchestration, and judgment rather than queue/ticket processing.</p>
<p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Execute client risk assessments end to end: document collection, interviews, scoring against the weighted risk typologies, written assessment, tier determination, and pre-launch conditions.</li>
<li>Own program underwriting: apply and maintain underwriting criteria, recommend spend, transfer, and reserve limits, and reassess programs as volume, product mix, and financial condition change.</li>
<li>Run third party risk operations: vendor intake and tiering, due diligence and certification report review, control effectiveness ratings, the vendor risk register, annual reviews, and vendor issue and incident tracking.</li>
<li>Support the enterprise risk assessment and the risk register: maintain the assessment inventory and calendar, collect and test control evidence, apply the enterprise rating methodology consistently across sub-assessments, and prepare Enterprise Risk Committee materials.</li>
<li>Continuously improve the programs: refine rubrics, weights, questionnaires, and templates based on observed outcomes, and author and maintain the SOPs that make each assessment repeatable by someone other than you.</li>
<li>Test, deploy, and tune agentic tooling across the assessment workflows, including document review, questionnaire analysis, vendor due diligence, and drafting, and document the context that makes the output repeatable and defensible.</li>
<li>Define and report the KPIs and KRIs for the assessment programs, and surface concentration, trend, and thematic findings to leadership and oversight forums.</li>
<li>Serve as the evidence owner for partner bank, audit, and examiner requests touching client, third party, and enterprise risk assessment.</li>
<li>Mentor and cross-train teammates on assessment methodology, scoring discipline, and the tooling.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Hands-on experience conducting risk assessments in fintech, payments, or banking, across client or counterparty, third party or vendor, and enterprise or operational risk.</li>
<li>Working knowledge of underwriting fundamentals: financial statement review, liquidity and runway analysis, loss and exposure monitoring, and limit setting.</li>
<li>Fluency with rubric-based scoring methodologies and the discipline to apply them consistently and defend a rating.</li>
<li>A track record of owning discrete risk programs end to end with limited guidance, including authoring the SOPs and defining the metrics that govern them.</li>
<li>Ability to read control reports (ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS AOC) and translate findings into a residual risk position and a remediation ask.</li>

      <title>Salesloft: Principal Software Engineer, AI</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<p><span><strong>Job Title:</strong> Principal Software Engineer, AI&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span><strong>Location</strong>: Remote - US</span></p>
<p>Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.</p>
<p>With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.</p>
<p>Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.</p>
<p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p>
<p>At Salesloft, our Principal Engineer for AI sets the technical direction for how machine intelligence works across our Predictive Revenue System. This is the most senior individual-contributor role on our AI engineering team: you will architect the systems that turn LLMs, machine learning models, and agentic workflows into production capabilities that thousands of enterprise revenue teams depend on.</p>
<p>This is deep, ambiguous, frontier work. You will make the foundational architectural decisions for AI at Salesloft — how we serve models at scale, how we build reliable systems on top of non-deterministic components, how we evaluate and guardrail agentic behavior, and how we keep pace as the underlying foundation models evolve. You will set the standards other engineers build on and act as a technical multiplier across the AI organization.</p>
<p>On a day-to-day basis, you will:</p>
<ul>
<li>Set the technical architecture and direction for AI systems across the platform — model serving, LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, and the infrastructure beneath them.</li>
<li>Design production-grade systems that are reliable and observable despite being built on non-deterministic, probabilistic AI components.</li>
<li>Architect evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and quality systems that make AI behavior safe, measurable, and trustworthy at enterprise scale.</li>
<li>Lead the most complex AI engineering problems end to end — from research-adjacent prototyping through hardened production delivery.</li>
<li>Establish engineering standards and best practices for building AI-native systems, and mentor senior engineers across the org.</li>
<li>Keep the platform at the frontier by evaluating and integrating advances in foundation models, agent frameworks, and the modern AI stack.</li>
</ul>
<p>This role lives at the heart of how we Lead From the Front: you'll work at the edge of applied AI, prototype rapidly, and make architectural bets ahead of the field. And in the spirit of how we Make Your Mark, you'll set the AI engineering standards and systems that the entire organization builds on — engineered for scale, not for a demo.</p>
<p><strong>WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for an engineer who operates at the highest level of technical authority in AI systems — someone who has architected and shipped production AI at scale and understands the deep challenges of building reliable systems on probabilistic foundations. You lead through technical credibility and make the engineers around you better.</p>
<p>You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — you make architectural decisions from evaluation data and evidence rather than hype, you invite rigorous challenge, and you change direction when the models or the data move. You bring systems thinking to a genuinely unsolved problem space and build for durability.</p>
<p>This is the right role if you want to define how AI works on a platform at the center of enterprise revenue.</p>
<p><strong>THE TEAM</strong></p>
<p>The Salesloft AI Engineering organization builds the machine intelligence at the core of the Predictive Revenue System. The team works at the intersection of applied research and production engineering, in close partnership with Product, Data Science, and Data Platform Engineering.</p>
<p>The team Moves as One — AI engineering, product, and data science share ownership of shipping trustworthy AI and make hard technical calls together. And we are relentlessly Customer Inspired: every AI capability is measured against whether it makes revenue teams genuinely more successful and more confident in the system.</p>
<p><strong>THE SKILL SET</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Extensive experience building and architecting production software systems at scale, with significant depth in AI/ML systems.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience building production systems on top of LLMs or machine learning models — including designing for the challenges of non-deterministic behavior.</li>
<li>Deep expertise in distributed systems, model serving, and the infrastructure required to run AI reliably at scale.</li>
<li>Proven experience designing evaluation frameworks, guardrails, or quality systems for AI-driven features.</li>
<li>A track record of setting technical architecture and standards across teams and mentoring senior engineers.</li>
<li>Strong command of a major programming language (e.g., Python, Java, or Go) and modern cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP).</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with agentic systems — designing and hardening AI agents that take autonomous action in production.</li>
<li>Depth in the modern AI stack — retrieval-augmented generation, vector stores, agent frameworks, model orchestration, or evaluation tooling.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>BENEFITS:</strong></p>
<p>For more information about our company's comprehensive benefits please visit: https://salesloftbenefits.com/</p>
<p>At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.</p>
<p>We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p>
<p>If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!</p>
<p>Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Clari + Salesloft will come from&nbsp;@ <a href="http://salesloft.com">salesloft.com</a> email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official <a href="https://salesloft.com/company/careers/">Careers Page</a>.</p>
<p><em>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment - all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.</em></p>
<p>#LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>It is Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable.&nbsp; The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.</p>
<p>The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.&nbsp;</p></div><div class="title">Base Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$165,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$185,000 USD</span></div></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/salesloft-principal-software-engineer-ai">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/salesloft-principal-software-engineer-ai</a></p>
</description>

<p><strong>About Tailscale&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. <p>We are looking for an Analytics Engineer who thrives in high-complexity environments—someone excited to bring clarity to chaos, untangle complex models, and lay down the foundation for scalable solutions.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who isn’t afraid to address manual processes, viewing them as opportunities to build scalable solutions that drive meaningful impact. <li>Ability to manage time, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.</li>
<li>Clear communication skills with both technical and non-technical collaborators.</li>
<li>Willingness to flexibly support other domains (e.g., Product, Marketing, and Engineering) as the team grows.</li>
</ul>

<ul>
<li>Experience at a high-growth PLG SaaS company.</li>
<li>A track record of transforming manual, ad hoc workflows into scalable data pipelines.</li>
<li>Familiarity with billing systems, GAAP accounting, revenue recognition, or audit support.</li>
<li>Exposure to Stripe, Salesforce, or Orb in billing and finance contexts.</li>
<li>Familiarity with financial cycles and the need for fast iteration during month- and quarter-end.</li>
</ul>

<ul>
<li>Snowflake, dbt, Hightouch, Fivetran, Looker, Stripe, Salesforce, Orb.</li>
</ul>

<ul>

<li><strong>A competitive total compensation package.</strong> This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).</li>
<li><strong>Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. </strong>Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!</li>
<li><strong>Remote first company</strong>—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.</li>
<li><strong>Employer-funded retirement contributions. </strong>Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.</li>

      <title>Lithic: Senior Software Engineer, Card Authorization</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote 
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.</p>
<p>Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.</p>
<p>We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.&nbsp;</p></div><p>We are hiring a <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> for Lithic’s Card Authorization team, which owns the real-time systems that make every card authorization decision correct, reliable, and fast. The team also owns related fraud tooling, including Lithic’s Rules Engine and 3D Secure integration. You’ll own high-impact projects end-to-end, solve distributed-systems problems at scale, and help build the tools customers use to control fraud and payment risk.</p>
<h3><strong>What you'll do:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Write reliable, secure, scalable code for Lithic’s real-time authorization and fraud-prevention systems with minimal tech debt</li>
<li>Build customer-facing features, such as rules improvements, velocity controls, 3DS flows, fraud tooling, and transaction monitoring. Own projects from planning to launch.</li>
<li>Improve the reliability of systems in team’s scope and participate in the team on-call rotation</li>
<li>Lead efforts to improve systems and processes within the team</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>4+ years building production backend systems. Full stack experience is a plus.</li>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco Bay Area (or Remote U.S.)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: <strong>play video games.</strong> Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.</p></div><p>Discord's Safety ML team builds the machine learning systems that protect 200M+ users. The team's mission is to make Discord a place where people can build genuine friendships without exposure to harm, at a scale where manual review alone can never keep up.</p>
<p>We're looking for a highly technical, hands-on, and mission-driven Engineering Manager to lead our Safety ML team. As the manager responsible for Safety ML, you will own the detection systems that sit between attackers and our users; real-time and batch models for content understanding, account integrity, and platform abuse.</p>
<p><strong>What You'll Be Doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build and lead an exceptional team of highly-engaged ML engineers by hiring, coaching, and instilling a sense of ownership and impact.</li>
<li>Drive the technical vision and roadmap for Safety ML by collaborating with your team and partners across Trust &amp; Safety, Product, Policy, Legal, and Data Science.</li>
<li>Own the end-to-end lifecycle of production safety models: defining new capabilities, measuring performance, and monitoring the operational health of systems that make millions of enforcement decisions per day.</li>
<li>Manage processes and leverage your technical expertise to continually raise the bar and ensure your team delivers extraordinary results.</li>
<li>Partner with Trust &amp; Safety on label quality, golden sets, and automating manual investigations.</li>
<li>Work with other Engineering Managers to continuously improve the Engineering organization and uphold our <a href="https://blog.discordapp.com/the-four-values-of-working-at-discord-90d5b5102cbc">workplace philosophy</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What you should have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>You have 5+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, Data Scientist, or Applied Scientist.</li>
<li>You have 3+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager and successfully managed a team of 5+ engineers.</li>
<li>You have hands-on depth in at least one of: abuse/fraud detection, content classification, behavioral modeling, graph-based modeling, or LLM-based classification systems.</li>
<li>You have strong communication skills and the ability to work well cross-functionally.</li>
<li>You thrive in ambiguous environments and get excited about figuring out solutions to complex problems, and then executing on them.</li>
<li>You are a first principles thinker that can work with others to come up with pragmatic solutions.</li>
<li>You have a proven record of shipping ML systems to production at scale.</li>
<li>You are passionate about coaching and leading other engineers, but can roll up your sleeves and get elbow deep in code when needed.</li>
<li>You keep up with the industry trends and continuously identify new technologies to leverage to solve technical problems</li>
</ul>
<p><em><br>The US base salary range for this full-time position is $272,000 to $340,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.<br></em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Why Discord?&nbsp;</strong><br><br>Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. <strong>Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!</strong></p>
